items.title: A weighted cosine-frame bound and its Gaussian second-moment sum

source.anchor: Appendix C.2 EGx11 (Ex115–Ex117), with Ex113–Ex114, p14.3, Fact C.5, exact p1/p10 definitions and standing 2q+1<d
source.attribution: On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling, arXiv:2610.20492v1.
source.scope: Deterministic coefficient comparison and canonical marginal realization of the uncentered second-moment sum.

items.statement: The weighted cosine coefficient is bounded by \(\frac{2r(r+2)}d I_{r^2}\). The truncated Gaussian row templates satisfy the same bound after summing their marginal second moments.
assumptions: Let \(d,q\in\mathbb N\), \(2q+1<d\), and \(r=q+1\). Thus \(d\ge2\), \(r\ge1\), and \(q=0\) is included.
For source rows \(i=1,\ldots,d\), put \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(t_i[0]=1\), and \(t_i[k]=\sqrt2\cos(k\theta_i)\) for \(1\le k\le q\). Lean uses source index \(i.val+1\).
Write \(S_i=\|t_i\|^2=\sum_{k=0}^q t_i[k]^2\) and \(F_i=t_it_i^\top\). All matrices are real, and paired tensor indices put the Gaussian/identity coordinate first and the feature coordinate second.

For the consumer only, \(Z\) has the canonical standard Gaussian probability law \(\gamma_r=N(0,I_r)\) on real Euclidean space, \(R=\|Z\|^2\), and \(L=2r+3\log(1000d)\). The cutoff is the closed event \(R\le L\).

The square is ordinary matrix multiplication. Every \(Y_i^2\) is proved Bochner integrable in the Euclidean operator norm. Each integral is a marginal expectation against \(\gamma_r\), with no retained-mass normalization.
The order \(\preceq\) means that the upper-minus-lower matrix is positive semidefinite. No Gram, norm, moment, integrability or order certificate is an extra hypothesis.

obligations.label: EGx11 weighted coefficient with an actual integrable marginal-sum consumer.

bindings.boundary: This local result gives the deterministic weighted coefficient and the integrable canonical marginal second-moment sum. The same dummy integration variable in separate marginal integrals does not identify the original row family. Original-family row maps, marginal-law and expectation adapters, joint independence, centered variance, variance operator norms, Bernstein, Fact C.6 and full Lemma 4.4 remain open. Both main lower bounds, exact oracle/TV/precision/cost adapters, serialized integration, full desktop/mobile source-index/graph delivery and purification remain open.

assumption_deltas.source: Exact half-grid features, r=q+1 and standing 2q+1<d.
assumption_deltas.lean: Literal zero-based midpoint grid and features, q natural and q=0 retained.
assumption_deltas.reason: The index shift is source row i.val+1. All norm and Gram estimates are internal compiled dependencies.

assumption_deltas.source: The middle and final comparisons in EGx11 are deterministic consequences of the feature norm and Gram identities.
assumption_deltas.lean: A separate deterministic PSD coefficient theorem, with no Gaussian-law or moment binder.
assumption_deltas.reason: The scalar r+2 is a literal coefficient in this comparison. Local B denotes B_coeff, not the source rectangular random matrix.

assumption_deltas.source: EGx11 sums expectations on the original Gaussian row family.
assumption_deltas.lean: The private consumer sums integrals of literal row templates against canonical stdGaussian and proves each square integrable.
assumption_deltas.reason: This is the explicit canonical marginal realization. Original-family row maps, marginal laws and expectation transport remain open and are not inferred from a repeated dummy integration variable.
